Done. ER11 B-08 control critic (I08, M15) complete — all science saved before native Goal terminal completion, ~14 min ahead of the 21:26:07Z deadline.

Top finding: the investigator draft is structurally honest (per-P dispositions, executed/proposed separated, absences declared) but its InvenTree availability precedent contradicts its own loanable-query claim, its PocketBase privacy oracle (403) is wrong for documented 200/404 behavior, and its OIDC "unproven" verdict stops one section short of the OAuth2 mechanism on the same page — plus unevidenced retention/MFA/roles and invented 60s/no-training gates. Full audit in the artifacts.

Artifacts (write root `jobs/B-08/control/critic/`):

- [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-08/control/critic/source-map.json) — immutable C01–C06 with URL/version/locator/access timestamps, observed operations, drift, billing null
- [sources/evidence.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-08/control/critic/sources/evidence.md) + [sources/index.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-08/control/critic/sources/index.md) — bounded excerpts, navigable index
